description: This file defines the DemoNotificationsSettingsStore class responsible for persisting demo notification settings and schedule state using Android's SharedPreferences. It provides methods to check if demo mode is enabled, enable/disable demo mode, retrieve/set pending schedule JSON, and clear all demo settings.

classes.name: DemoNotificationsSettingsStore
classes.description: Class managing persistence of demo notifications settings and schedule states, encapsulating SharedPreferences interactions.

methods.name: isDemoEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether demo notifications mode is enabled.

methods.name: setDemoEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables demo notifications mode, persisting the state.

methods.name: getPendingScheduleJson
methods.description: Retrieves the persisted JSON string of the pending demo schedule, or null if not set.

methods.name: setPendingScheduleJson
methods.description: Sets or clears the JSON snapshot of the pending demo schedule.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all demo notification settings and schedule state.
